task.title: Access the Vibration Z-axis FFT dB
task.shortdesc: This section describes the process of accessing the Vibration Z-axis FFT graph.

context.p: This section describes the process of accessing the Vibration Z-axis FFT graph.
To access the Vibration Z-axis FFT dB through the application:

step.cmd: Select the location associated with the motor.
From the subsequent screens, select the corresponding process, plant, and motor name.
Tap Select Vibration to select Vibration Z FFT dB.
Tap Select Date and Select Time to select the date and time corresponding to the moment of the installation.

info.p: You should see the corresponding waveform as shown in Figure 26.

fig.title: Dashboard screen showing the Vibration Z FFT waveform

step.cmd: Click DATA DOWNLOADto download the generated data.
